categories.main_business_segments: Shaanxi Huaqin Technology Industry Co., Ltd. primarily operates in special functional materials, aerospace parts intelligent processing and manufacturing, acoustic metamaterials and instruments, ceramic matrix composites for aerospace, and ultrafine crystal parts manufacturing. The company also engages in related technical services and testing, covering a broad product matrix in the aerospace and advanced new materials sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary technologies in mid-to-high temperature special functional materials, multi-spectrum compatible materials, structural-functional integrated composites, high-efficiency thermal barrier materials, heavy anti-corrosion coatings, electromagnetic shielding materials, acoustic metamaterials, laser ultrasonic nondestructive testing, and ceramic matrix composite fabrication. Production methods include customized coating processes, precision machining, composite material synthesis, and advanced manufacturing techniques such as additive manufacturing.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers are primarily in the aerospace industry, including aviation and aerospace equipment manufacturers. The company also serves sectors such as energy, power generation, industrial manufacturing, transportation, and high-end electronics. Its products are critical for aerospace engines, aircraft structures, and other high-performance equipment.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly within China, with headquarters and major facilities in Xi'an, Shaanxi Province, and subsidiaries in regions including Shenyang, Nanjing, Shanghai, and Anhui. Its market coverage is predominantly domestic, serving Chinese aerospace and advanced manufacturing sectors.
categories.supply_chain_position: Huaqin Technology operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the aerospace materials supply chain. It develops and manufactures advanced materials and components, providing specialized coatings, composite materials, and precision parts directly to aerospace manufacturers and system integrators.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes continuous innovation in special functional materials and aerospace new materials, deepening 'industry-university-research-application' collaboration. R&D focuses include multi-functional composites, thermal barrier coatings, acoustic metamaterials, and ultrafine crystal metals. It aims to enhance product performance, expand application fields, and maintain technological leadership domestically and internationally.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through direct sales of special functional materials, aerospace parts manufacturing services, acoustic metamaterials and instruments, and technical service contracts. The company also earns income from customized product development, testing services, and licensing of proprietary technologies.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Huaqin Technology is a leading innovative enterprise in China's aerospace new materials industry, with a strong domestic market position and recognized technological advantages. It competes with other high-tech material suppliers in aerospace and advanced manufacturing sectors, leveraging its comprehensive product portfolio and R&D capabilities to maintain a competitive edge.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.14 billion, a 24.17% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 414 million, up 23.56%. Total assets reached RMB 6.05 billion, growing 17.15% from the previous year. The company maintains a robust growth trajectory supported by increased production capacity and expanded business segments.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Huaqin Technology offers a unique value proposition through its wide-ranging special functional materials that operate across full temperature ranges and multiple spectra, integrated structural-functional composites, and advanced acoustic metamaterials. Its products provide high reliability, performance under extreme conditions, and customized solutions for aerospace and high-end equipment manufacturers, supported by strong R&D and quality assurance systems.
